perks.name: Hearth-Bonded
perks.description: Better dialogue, larger reputation gains from social actions, stronger Hearthfire from rest and feasts.

drawbacks.name: Vulnerable
drawbacks.description: Takes the full effect of vacuum, radiation, toxins and extreme temperature.

drawbacks.name: Fatigue
drawbacks.description: More than 6 days without docking leaves you Fatigued (-1 to all rolls).

summary: A Kin mind housed in a machine frame.

perks.name: Reinforced Frame
perks.description: +1 Grit. Shrugs off vacuum, radiation, toxins, heat and cold.

perks.name: Machine Link
perks.description: Extra console options with ship systems, old machinery and Votann tech.

drawbacks.name: Wear
drawbacks.description: Damage and console actions add Wear. High Wear penalises Nerve and Craft; 100 Wear incapacitates.

drawbacks.name: Low Hearthfire influence
drawbacks.description: Gains morale from kept oaths and crew bonds, not from rest and feasts.

drawbacks.name: Social friction
drawbacks.description: Some factions are wary of Ironkin; others respect them.
